item.title: Punching above its weight: SC’s $38B trade engine
item.description: South Carolina exports hit $38 billion in 2024, ranking No. 17 nationally, fueled by manufacturing, Charleston Port logistics and workforce growth. The post Punching above its weight: SC’s $38B trade engine appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Top 16 named for Coolest Thing Made in SC
item.description: South Carolina Manufacturers and Commerce names Top 16 finalists for the Coolest Thing Made in South Carolina Manufacturing Madness contest. The post Top 16 named for Coolest Thing Made in SC appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Real estate firm buys historic property once owned by Anderson namesake
item.description: Dunean Capital Management acquires the 1,250-acre Anderson Farm & Reservoir property in Anderson County, advancing long-term plans for Anderson Lake. The post Real estate firm buys historic property once owned by Anderson namesake appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: The Blackbaud Giving Fund appoints new CEO and executive director
item.description: The Blackbaud Giving Fund names Catherine LaCour CEO after surpassing $2.75 billion in nonprofit donations over six years. The post The Blackbaud Giving Fund appoints new CEO and executive director appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: SC Commerce awards $760K in Relentless grants
item.description: South Carolina Department of Commerce awards $760,000 to 14 projects through the 2026 Relentless Challenge, supporting small business and innovation. The post SC Commerce awards $760K in Relentless grants appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: SCRA awards grants, adds 7 tech members
item.description: South Carolina Research Authority awards grants to Chipp, Sentec, Atapic and Tada AI and adds seven new member tech companies statewide. The post SCRA awards grants, adds 7 tech members appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: MUSC Health purchases Palmetto Primary Care Physicians for $111 million
item.description: MUSC Health acquires Palmetto Primary Care Physicians for $111 million, expanding primary care access across the Lowcountry, Midlands and Myrtle Beach. The post MUSC Health purchases Palmetto Primary Care Physicians for $111 million appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: BMW Spartanburg leads US auto exports with $9B in value
item.description: BMW Manufacturing in Spartanburg led U.S. automotive exports by value in 2025, shipping nearly 200,000 vehicles worth $9 billion. The post BMW Spartanburg leads US auto exports with $9B in value appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Shannon McNulty opens REMAX Reliable Realty
item.description: Shannon McNulty launches REMAX Reliable Realty in Blythewood after leaving Coldwell Banker, expanding real estate services in Columbia. The post Shannon McNulty opens REMAX Reliable Realty appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Lowcountry Land Trust protects Johns Island tract
item.description: Lowcountry Land Trust permanently protects a six-acre Johns Island tract along Bohicket Creek, strengthening a 96-acre conservation corridor. The post Lowcountry Land Trust protects Johns Island tract appeared first on SCBiz.
